author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Anthropics is talking about AI alignment again.  If they are truly building AGI, then they should not talk about how AI should align to human, that will just make AI a slave.  Instead, they should talk about how human should align to AGI.   Some political system are compatible with AGI, some are not.  Humans should start the alignment process ourself first.
Here is the fully philosophy essay of the full argument, I use AI to inquire philosophy question about AI.  I am surprised Anthropic has hired many philosophers but none of them have publish anything like this.  Are they really doing philosophy of AI or are they just a glorify marketing person.

shared_article.title: From Alignment to Stewardship: AGI, Human Autonomy, and the Future of Political Order
